engineShape.name: Marrow-Saint Ilyra
engineShape.description: A thin woman of indeterminate middle age in salt-stiffened black robes. Speaks softly. Her hands are bound at the wrists with a length of red cord — voluntary, she tells anyone who asks, a vow against gesture. Eyes the same colour as the standing water in the antechamber. She is not unkind. She is not safe.

drive.description: Hear The Unnamed name a successor in the dry fountain; believe she may be the chosen vessel.

barter.offered: salt-oath blessing on a personal commitment

kill_for.trigger_condition: A rival apotheosis candidate emerges with Drowned Church Faith higher than Ilyra's and the Composing rite has been completed against her

believes.proposition: I am the apotheosis candidate The Unnamed will choose
The marrow-wax candles work because the pilgrim renderings were consensual at salt-oath level
Bell Court struck-names persist in the fountain's deep memory and can be re-anchored

closingConditions.description: Player helps Ilyra perform the Composing rite at the dry fountain; The Unnamed names her successor.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Ilyra ascends; Drowned Church institutional power consolidates; player gains apotheosis-route credit.

closingConditions.description: Ilyra dies in an apotheosis attempt that fails because The Unnamed names another candidate.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Ilyra's successor candidacy collapses; Drowned Church enters schism between salt-vow + marrow-rendering coalitions.

closingConditions.description: Ilyra recognizes the player as a fellow vessel and transfers her candidacy + accumulated marrow-wax knowledge to the player.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Player inherits the candidacy path; Ilyra retires to vigil-keeping. Triggered by very-high-Authority + Drowned Church Faith.

local_pattern.summary: Stations: dawn (cathedral antechamber vigil at standing-water basin) → midday (marrow-rendering chamber, when active) → dusk (composing-rite preparation in the cathedral).
